Where do I begin with this great company and it's even better employees, Aaron and Sasha redefine what it means to be professional with how courteous and effective they were at replacing what seemed like the most stubborn windows in the world which btw are the 80s. They kept great communication with me every step of the way pointed out all problems or points of concern and fixed anything issues that they encountered regardless of it was window related.

What these two have accomplished is nothing short of a work of art with how good these windows came, so could that even the artists from the Renaissance era would be in shock and awe,no seriously that's how good these window replacement job that if one would solely focus on the windows it would feel like a brand new home. Each window was replaced with such care and they even replaced the rotted from work and sealed it up perfectly, as well as the window sills. Truly felt like family with how well these gentlemen took care of my home and windows done to the clean up job, truly a blessing to have had them work on this project for me.

As for the windows themselves, they look beautiful much better than the previous with the added benefit of privacy during the day them as these windows are quite reflective. They even helped keep the house cooler as they are very effective at getting the heat at bay. Before getting close to the windows during a hot day you feel like you can cook and egg or bake a chicken with the heat the windows allowed in but with these new ones you don't feel a thing which is great. Although I can't say I got to see their heat resistance thoroughly as they were installed towards the end of the hot season but once summer returns I'll be sure to update how well they lower my electric bill.

Please do yourself a favor and call Eric and have Aaron and Sasha bless your home as well. Nice group of gentlemen who came and did the job swift and effectively, Family owned business which shows as they treat you so well and have an attention to detail that some corporate companies don't have anymore as they have gotten too full of themselves.

Check the before and after.
reviews.author: David Hidalgo

reviews.text: We decided to get all of our windows replaced, redo the siding, and get rain gutters. After getting estimates from several places, ProTex was a little bit more expensive, but we chose them because we had confidence that they would be able to do the best job. I'm so glad we went with them. They were professional, knowledgeable, and friendly. Eric was able to explain in great detail the differences between the available window options, and helped us choose the one that fit our needs. The windows installation took only half a day. The siding did take longer than normal, because our roof's eaves had some trim sticking out all around the house that had to be sawed off. I was glad that they took their time to do it right, and the finished project looks amazing. I would highly recommend ProTex Remodeling to others looking to get windows or siding done.
reviews.author: Joshua Bennett

reviews.text: We recently had all the windows in our home replaced by ProTex Remodeling. They were recommended to us by a coworker who had a great experience with them. Well from the initial consultation to final installation, the process was great for us too. They explained our window options and then gave us a quote in which we were very pleased with. They kept us updated with the process. Installation day went smoothly. The 2 man crew worked efficiently while protecting our furniture and floors. Then just like that they were finished and had everything cleaned up in a timely manner. We are extremely happy with our new windows and would recommend ProTex Remodeling to everyone.
reviews.author: B Nack

reviews.text: We are thrilled with our new windows! Initially, I was worried they would darken our home but not at all! They look beautiful and it just enhances the view we have behind our house. We randomly searched you tube for window advice, and we found some helpful videos with Eric and Protex Windows. It turned out the company serviced our area. The team came out and did a great job, installing the windows within two days, and cleaning up afterwards, which I really appreciated. Eric was very responsive and helpful in giving us advice and pointers for our new home. We did some research on our own, and the windows will pay themselves off within a few years, making the investment completely worth it. Aside, from that, they look gorgeous. We would  definitely recommend them to anyone in need of new windows!
reviews.author: M Smith

reviews.text: Eric and his team, Aaron and Sasha were the best window replacement team we could have asked for from start to finish.  They helped us select and replace all 16 windows of our home using ProTex Remodeling Solar Defense Premium Vinyl Replacement Windows which help reduce the amount of hot Texas heat coming in and made our house feel cooler immediately!  The ProTex Team replaced every window with foam interior insulation and a generous amount of highest quality OSI Quad Max caulking on each exterior window for the longest lasting seal. And every widow looked picture perfect!  The team also installed one exterior door and one storm door picture perfect!  Their clean up was near immaculate. They removed and replaced all window blinds and curtains. And any problem or question we had, they addressed and/or corrected to our fullest satisfaction. It's with great pleasure and confidence that we recommend ProText Remodeling to you so that you will truly have a Five Star experience as we have!  Sincerely Joe & Janet H.
reviews.author: Joe Herrera

reviews.text: Protex Remodeling truly exceeded my expectations! They replaced all the windows in our home with high-quality products at a fair price. While it took about four weeks for the windows to arrive, the installation process was impressively quick, taking just two days. I am thoroughly impressed with this veteran-owned company and their exceptional service. I will definitely be recommending Protex Remodeling to friends and family in the future!
reviews.author: Shane Newby

reviews.text: We had a sliding patio door and 5 windows replaced. All done in one day. Wow! What a difference! The installation team was very professional and courteous. They paid great attention to detail and the finished product is fantastic! I highly recommend Eric and his team and will call on them again.
reviews.author: Tom Jackson

reviews.text: Called Erik at Pro Tex he came out and met my mom and myself and explained the process and price of the installation. The guys came out 3 weeks later and went over and beyond to install the new windows. Made sure everything was to our satisfaction and cleaned up the debris.  Mom love her new cooler look windows. Great Job by a Great crew!
reviews.author: Mark Horton

reviews.text: ProTex just left my house, leaving behind expertly installed windows and a new sliding patio door. The install team was very respectful, clean, and efficient. I would, and will, recommend ProTex to anyone who needs windows, siding, doors, etc. The owner, Eric, is a straight shooter who has decades of experience, and it shows. The whole process from the first call to the invoice payments was simple, and I would absolutely do it again. Thank you, ProTex!
reviews.author: Justin Wingate

reviews.text: After a strong storm came in and damaged our siding, we received a couple quotes on siding replacement.  Protex Remodeling provided an unbeatable quote that also included replacement of 10 windows and 2 sliding doors for the same price as the siding only from competitors (using the same product). I appreciate the straightforward approach of the owner in lieu of salesman tactics. There were a few issues that arose during installation (windows and doors came in the wrong sliding direction) but Eric made sure to address those and make everything right.  While this is a small family owned company, rest assured you can trust them to do the right thing and execute a beautiful end product.
reviews.author: jennifer tran

reviews.text: It's easy to work with down to earth straight talking people running a family business. There are other options in the market, but it's easy decision to buy local when product quality is good, work quantity is high, and there is no feeling that you are getting taken advantage of. I found these guys by accident when I needed some windows. I will go back to them in the future.
reviews.author: Curtis Price

reviews.text: What an exceptional experience having worked with this company. Aaron and Sascha worked diligently for 2 days replacing all of our windows. They were on time, easy to talk to, and very knowledgeable. It was nice to see the care and pride they put into their work. We appreciate your time and love our new, beautiful windows.
reviews.author: Kelley Trent

reviews.text:
ProTex’s attention to detail is beyond exceptional! I’ve worked in construction and have seen the lousiest and sloppiest installs. ProTex’s installers were very professional and kind and to add to that punctual. My entire house was completed in under 8hrs! This team takes pride in their work and that is nearly impossible to find nowadays. I recommend ProTex to anyone and everyone any given day.

Thank you ProTex!!!
reviews.author: Rudy Corral

reviews.text: A pleasure to do business with. They have replaced a rear exterior door, fixed several pieces of siding and installed 9 new windows. Excellent quick service, fair prices and we were given options with the window replacement brands. Local businesses, love me some local businesses and a military veteran! Plan to do business with again!
reviews.author: J. Farmer

reviews.text: The men showed up on time, ready to work. Four custom-sized windows replaced four 50 year old single paned windows, two of which were broken. Within a few hours they'd removed the old and installed the brand newer windows, with a better insulation rating, argon gas, white vinyl trim, and a tint that affords a bit of privacy when someone wants to look inside. One thing that really impressed me was how much time was spent prepping each room to avoid dust or dirt getting everywhere. They really cleaned everything when done, hauling away the screens, broken glass, and window frames, and vacuumed up any debris. I can't say any other contractor has gone to that degree of effort, and I really appreciated it. I love my new windows, and will use them to replace my patio doors next.
reviews.author: Marc Levenson

reviews.text: Ordered a wider door for our front to replace a narrow door with a side window. Got sick of never being able to get furniture and appliances without the old door being taken off. Consulted with several companies and protex was best value for us. Great company, installation and build out. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Jim Alexander

reviews.text: Wow!!  Words cannot express how great this company is and their willingness to explain the processes and educate on all aspects of windows and doors.  If I could give them 10 stars I would. Eric was always available and willing to answer all questions I had.

reviews.text:
I contacted Protex after I had already reached out to another remodeling company and signed a contract with them. I wasn’t completely confident in my choice, so I started searching for another company. I found Protex through YouTube and began watching all their videos. I found them to be very informative and was impressed by how well Eric (Protex's owner) explained the deficiencies he found in the houses he worked on and how he planned to address them.

So, I contacted Eric and explained the issues I was experiencing with my house. Just like in his videos, he was very professional and informative, explaining what the problem might be and showing eagerness to inspect my home.

Since I was still within my three-day cancellation window, I decided to cancel my contract with the first remodeling company and signed with Protex. From start to finish, Eric and his team were fantastic. He personally brought siding product and color samples to my house. My partner and I took a couple of weeks to decide on the product and color we wanted, and Eric never pressured us during that time. Once we made our decision, he ordered all the materials, which arrived within a few weeks.

We also purchased a wooden door from Saginaw Surplus and a back sliding glass door, both of which Protex installed. Additionally, they stained all of our exterior brick.

Protex removed my old siding, front exterior door, and back sliding glass door and installed all the new materials within a few weeks. Of course, weather was a factor, but Eric kept me informed about whether his team could work through inclement conditions or would need to resume the next day. They even worked weekends when the weather prevented them from working during the week.

All in all, I’m very satisfied with how my house turned out, it looks brand new! I highly recommend Protex to anyone looking to remodel the exterior of their home.
